messages:
Ana Torres: hey @mike @cheng :wave: kicking off Kyoto APAC edge marketplace onboarding with EdgeZone. Need quota + KMS + joint announcement timing. partner wants initial capacity of 4 A100 nodes, entitlements in marketplace, and PR the week after onboarding.
Mike Patel: got it. who owns the legal/CLA side and what's the exact SKU/quotas we should request?
Ana Torres: SKU: edgezone.kyoto.gpu.a100. Request: 4 reserved nodes, burst to 8 for first 2 weeks. Partner intends BYOK. Need us to approve network peering + ingress allowlist.
Ana Torres: snippet for entitlement request:
```
{
  "partner": "EdgeZone",
  "region": "apac-kyoto",
  "sku": "edgezone.kyoto.gpu.a100",
  "reserved_nodes": 4,
  "burst_nodes": 8,
  "kms": "partner-byo-kms"
}
```
Cheng Li: cc @Emma for infra/network. I'll open the marketplace entitlement ticket. Typical approval 3-5 biz days but we can escalate. tagging Marketplace Bot.
Marketplace Bot: created ticket EZ-1247 -> https://marketplace.internal/tickets/EZ-1247. Status: awaiting partner-signed-CLA. Assigned: Partnerships queue.
Emma Johnson: reviewed network diagram. We'll need peering + ingress CIDR allowlist and a small NAT gateway plan. Also need compliance sign-off for BYOK. Ping me partner contact.
Rajesh Verma: partner legal sent a draft CLA yesterday. I'll review with compliance and confirm SOC2/data handling language for Kyoto. :thumbsup:
Ana Torres: partner contact: Taro Saito <taro@edgezone.co>. target announcement week: 2024-11-04. If quotas are approved by 2024-10-28 we can lock the PR and docs.
Mike Patel: pushing on cloud vendor quota side now, asked for expedited review. If needed we can provision temporary Dedicated pool to cover launch spikes. will update.
Marketplace Bot: EZ-1247 updated: partner-CLA required -> assigned to Emma Johnson, Rajesh Verma. Due date set to 2024-10-25.
Cheng Li: thanks — I'll draft the rollout checklist and canary traffic policy, will share link in a follow-up.
Ana Torres: perfect, will update EdgeZone and schedule a partner sync for tomorrow. thanks everyone :rocket:
